images.scene: A small open sailing boat glides past a wild African coastline while a group of black, naked people stand on the sandy shore watching it pass, one of them holding a long slender lance.
images.alt: People stand on a shore watching a small boat sail past.

images.scene: From his small boat Robinson raises his long musket and fires at a spotted leopard swimming in the sea close to the boat, a burst of smoke at the muzzle and the water splashing around the animal.
images.alt: A man in a small boat fires a gun at a leopard swimming in the sea.

images.scene: On the beach several villagers crouch around the dead spotted leopard, peeling off its skin with a sharpened piece of wood, while Robinson looks on from the shallows beside his boat.
images.alt: Villagers skin a dead leopard on a beach with a sharpened stick.

images.scene: Robinson's small boat draws alongside a large three-masted Portuguese sailing ship on the open sea, sailors leaning over the high side to help him and his boy come aboard.
images.alt: A small boat comes up alongside a large sailing ship at sea.

images.scene: In a raging storm a battered sailing ship lies grounded on a sandbar, a huge wave breaking clean over her deck in white foam and spray as the crew huddle in shelter.
images.alt: A sailing ship grounded on a sandbar as a huge wave breaks over it in a storm.

images.scene: At nightfall Robinson climbs into a thick, bushy, thorny fir-like tree near the shore, a short stick clutched in his hand, settling himself among the branches to sleep out of reach of wild beasts.
images.alt: A shipwrecked man climbs into a thorny tree at night holding a stick.
